topic: Adjusting cost for bus shelter inventory
summary_markdown:
The initial cost calculation for bus shelters in Vilnius and Klaipeda was deemed too high (€106K/year). It was agreed that reducing the number of screens by 50% would bring the estimated annual cost down to €70K, which was considered more reasonable. Later, final numbers were reviewed and confirmed as ready to be sent to Vadimas. The team also discussed the inclusion of a campaign module, but decided against it.

Separately, data from Lithuania (LT) was received via Esri portal after an offer had been submitted.
decisions: Reduce bus shelter screens in Vilnius/Klaipeda by 50% to lower annual cost to €70K.
action_items: Send final numbers and summary to Vadimas.
